outline: Matlab and Simulink, dynamic systems modeling, time-domain analysis, root locus analysis, frequency-domain analysis, PID controller design, lag-lead compensator design, case studies, and special topics.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Matlab Tutorial
Week 3: Simulink Tutorial
Week 4: Modeling and Simulation
Week 5: Time-Domain Analysis
Week 6: Root Locus Analysis
Week 7: Frequency-Domain Analysis
Week 8: PID Controller Design
Week 9: Delta HMI
Week 10: Delta PLC (1/2)
Week 11: Delta PLC (2/2)
Week 12: Delta VFD
Week 13: Delta ASDA (1/2)
Week 14: Delta ASDA (2/2)
Week 15: Delta Integrated Applications
Week 16: Final (hands-on)

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content: Week 17: 控制系統文獻研討; Week 18: 控制系統研討簡報。
flexible_learning.outcome: 研讀近年控制系統文獻，並以簡報方式呈現。

assessment: Lab Experiments: 60%, Final (hands-on): 25%, Participation: 5%, Study Reports: 10%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

3)	Delta Electronics, Operation and Application Manuals. [Online]. Available: http://www.deltaww.com/ia/downloads.
